summary: Verified the v2.2 crash fix for PackingListSection.TemplatePicker. Logged in as applereview@cheerplanner.app, opened both competitions (Summit Championship - upcoming with populated packing list; Worlds Tryout - past with empty packing list state). Both competition detail screens render fully with all required sections: hero card, Athletes attending, Our Teams Attending, Teams to Watch, Travel & accommodations, Packing list. Opened the TemplatePicker modal from BOTH code paths (populated state via 'Templates' chip on Summit, and empty state via 'Apply template' button on Worlds Tryout) — modal opens cleanly showing 'Pick a template' with the CheerPlanner Standard template. No 'styles is not defined' error in DOM, no pageerrors, zero non-401 console errors. Fix is confirmed working end-to-end on the web preview.
critical_code_review_comments: PackingListSection.tsx line 414: const styles = useThemedStyles(makeStyles) is now correctly declared inside TemplatePicker (matches the parent component at line 43). Crash root cause resolved.
Minor: props.pointerEvents deprecation warning still emitted by some upstream RN component (not blocking, not introduced by this fix).
seed_data_creation: None - used existing seeded competitions (Summit Championship, Worlds Tryout) under applereview@cheerplanner.app.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix verified. Two competitions exist for the test account: Summit Championship (upcoming, packing list already populated with CheerPlanner Standard) and Worlds Tryout (past, no packing list -> empty state). Both code paths for TemplatePicker (populated state via packing-templates-btn, empty state via packing-apply-template-btn) render the modal correctly without the previous 'styles is not defined' crash.
rca_of_issue: ROOT CAUSE: The TemplatePicker functional component inside PackingListSection.tsx referenced styles.modalOverlay / styles.modalSheet / styles.modalHeader / styles.modalTitle / styles.templateRow / styles.templateName / styles.templateMeta / styles.primaryBtn / styles.primaryBtnText but never created its own `const styles = useThemedStyles(makeStyles)` binding (only the parent PackingListSection had it). Because TemplatePicker is rendered on every CompetitionDetail screen (both in populated and empty packing-list states), opening any competition triggered the ReferenceError. On web this surfaced as a red-screen overlay; on native iOS TestFlight (release JS, no error boundary) it propagated as a hard crash. FIX: Added `const styles = useThemedStyles(makeStyles);` at the top of the TemplatePicker function body (line 414). VERIFIED via Playwright: both competitions open cleanly, TemplatePicker modal opens from both entry points, no 'styles is not defined' string in DOM, zero pageerrors/console errors.
